unredacted.symptom: Users received a redundant 'HTTP 502' alert two days running, carrying nothing they could act on. The dataset records the artifact as 错误被稀释, 非编造 — the error was DILUTED, not fabricated (fail_plausible: no, llm_fabrication: no).
unredacted.mechanism_as_described: Class C — 错误吞噬与稀释 (error swallowing and dilution). The class is defined as: the error really happened, but was silently eaten by some layer, or the upstream cause was diluted while being passed across layers, so what the end user finally sees is 'success' or an alert that has lost its information. This case is the dilution sub-mechanism across 三跳 (three hops), adapter→proxy→client. Qwen3's circuit breaker was OPEN and Gemini returned 429; the adapter returned a 502; the proxy took only str(e) — 'HTTP 502' — without calling e.read() to get the response body carrying the detail; the client then raised its own HTTPError and dropped the body a second time. The true cause, 'gemini 429 quota 耗尽' (Gemini 429 quota exhaustion), was present at the first hop and 经 3 跳稀释完全不可见 — completely invisible after dilution across three hops. Nothing was swallowed outright; the cause was diluted at each boundary until only a transport code survived. Associated meta-rules: MR-4 (第 9 次 — its 9th recurrence), MR-13 error-chain-preserve-cause, INV-OBSERVABILITY-001.

unredacted.consequence: Two days of alerts naming a symptom nobody could act on, while the actual cause went unnamed. silence_span: days. The row is recorded as out-of-scope for the content-reading observer: 诚实边界 — an honest boundary, since a reader of content structurally cannot catch this.

unredacted.mechanism_as_described: Class E — 运维遗漏与取证盲区 (operational omission and forensic blind spot), here the operational-omission sub-mechanism, whose definition is: the code is correct but a deployment, registration or configuration step is missed — 声明态 ≠ 运行时态, declared state is not runtime state. The row's own omission point is 告警链依赖失效主体: the alert chain depends on the failing subject. restart.sh caused the Gateway to crash quickly after coming up, and 三放大器同时失效 — three amplifiers failed simultaneously: quiet_alert swallowed three CRITICALs in the small hours, wa_keepalive only wrote to a log and raised no alert, and restart.sh did not verify health after restarting. Every one of the three alerting paths ran through the component that had died. Amplifier is one layer of the 三层根因模式 — 触发器 / 放大器 / 掩护者 (trigger / amplifier / concealer) — the root-cause structure the catalog reports in nearly every case. Associated meta-rules: MR-4 (第 11 次 — its 11th recurrence), MR-14 alert-path-not-depend-on-failing-subject, INV-WA-001/QUIET-001.

unredacted.symptom: SSD backups to an external volume returned EPERM — permission errors — silently for 60 days, and 取证工具自身被静默拒: the forensic tools were themselves silently refused. 60 天 6 假说全证伪 — over 60 days, six successive hypotheses about the cause were each falsified. observable_artifact: 备份 EPERM, 无面向用户语义产物 — a backup EPERM with no user-facing semantic artifact. fail_plausible: no.
unredacted.mechanism_as_described: Class E — 运维遗漏与取证盲区 (operational omission and forensic blind spot), here the 取证盲区 / forensic-blind-spot sub-mechanism, whose definition is: the debugging tool is itself blocked and returns empty content, which is misread as 'normal', producing an extra-long latency. The true cause: macOS TCC Sandbox denies cron-spawned processes access to external volumes, because the cron daemon holds no FDA (full-disk access) by default. The reason it took 60 days to find is separate from the cause: at V37.9.30 the lsof and ACL collectors used to investigate were themselves 被 sandbox 拒绝 — refused by the same sandbox — and returned empty, and that empty output 被误读为 normal/empty 6 周: misread as 'nothing anomalous here' rather than 'this instrument was blocked', for six weeks. The system-log query that finally exposed the denial had never been run in those 60 days. The dataset row assigns taxonomy_class: A, while the catalog places the case under Class E and the same dataset row's paper_class_ref cites §4.5 E (forensic blind spot, 60-day). Associated meta-rules: MR-4, MR-10 (反向第 5 次教训 — the 5th reverse lesson), a candidate meta-rule macos-cron-fda, INV-MOVESPEED-TCC-001.
unredacted.detection_path: discovery_channel: log-forensics. Found once a system-log query with an explicit predicate was finally run.
unredacted.consequence: 60 days of silent backup failure — corpus 最长潜伏, the longest latency in the corpus and the paper's §5.1 headline — with six wrong hypotheses each consuming an investigation cycle. silence_span: 60 days. The design doc pins it as out-of-scope for the content-reading observer: a reader of content cannot see deployment or OS-policy seams, and prevention for this class comes from human eyes, adversarial audit, or target-environment exposure (audit-as-regression).
